messages.subject: DIB Workshops Announcement: Shell and Python Half Days 12/3
parts:
Workshops announcement: Shell and Python

Who: C. Titus Brown
When: December 3, 2015
Times: 9 am-12:15 pm (Shell workshop), 1:30 pm-4:30 pm (Python workshop)
Where: 1043 Valley Hall, UC Davis campus

Descriptions:

These are two separate half day workshops held on December 3rd.  Feel free to register for either workshop, or both.

Shell:
The morning workshop will provide an introduction to the UNIX shell. The shell is a very powerful tool for using scientific software and working with large data sets. It is primarily used to manage files and run programs, and it allows for automation of repetitive tasks.

Topics covered will include navigating the filesystem, managing and manipulating files, loops, and scripts.

More at:
http://dib-training.readthedocs.org/en/pub/2015-12-03-shell-halfday.html

Registration Link:
https://www.eventbrite.com/e/shell-half-day-workshop-tickets-19301439124

Python:
The afternoon workshop will introduce biologists to working in Python 3. Python is a very popular language for scientific computing and this workshop will show how it can be used in biology and other data-intensive research.

Topics covered will include loops, functions, data analysis using Python, and troubleshooting.

More at:
http://dib-training.readthedocs.org/en/pub/2015-12-03-python-halfday.html

Registration Link:
https://www.eventbrite.com/e/python-half-day-workshop-tickets-19300862399

Both workshops are open to everyone, including graduate students,
postdocs, staff, faculty, and the broader Bay Area community (including
IT and biotech). We have reserved space for UC Davis VetMed
affiliates; please contact the organizer if you are affiliated with
the SVM.

We especially encourage people to come with one or more colleagues
from their lab or research group!

----

This workshop is hosted by the Lab for Data Intensive Biology as part of
their training program; see

http://dib-training.readthedocs.org/en/pub/

for more information.
